purpose: Define UserModule identity and registry semantics so each module has stable logical identity independent of filesystem path, runtime instance state or presentation.

topics.name: UserModule Registry
topics.purpose: Define UserModule identity and registry semantics so each module has stable logical identity independent of filesystem path, runtime instance state or presentation.

semantics.identity_rule: UserModule identity is explicit and stable; filesystem path is storage, not identity.
semantics.registry_rule: #UM resolves registered UserModule semantic identities and instances.
semantics.collision_rule: Duplicate active logical identities are rejected.
semantics.path_rule: Moving a module source file does not redefine its semantic identity when the declared identity is unchanged.
semantics.authority_rule: Registration does not grant runtime authority beyond the module's declared capabilities and applicable policy.
semantics.instance_rule: Module definition identity and runtime instance identity are separate when multiple instances are permitted.

invariants.rule: UserModule identity, type, lifecycle, bindings and visibility are explicit canonical/runtime semantics.

hard_gates.condition: UserModule identity inferred solely from directory path
runtime instance state overwrites module definition identity
display name used as semantic identity

references.purpose: #UM is a registered runtime symbol root.
